title: The Fontaine-Mazur Conjecture on Geometric Galois Representations
exact_target: Must every irreducible Galois representation with the specified arithmetic and local geometric properties arise from algebraic geometry?

sources.citation: Sug Woo Shin and Nicolas Templier, On fields of rationality for automorphic representations, author version dated 2 July 2014.
James Newton, Modularity of Galois Representations and Langlands Functoriality.
Jack A. Thorne, Towards the Fontaine–Mazur conjecture for GL(2).
